
KALA 0.10 additions (27 October 2026)
All assets below are CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Bedroom and Living Room Furniture — 3DAssets.dev.
https://3dassets.dev/packs/bedroom-and-living-room-furniture
Source declares AI-assisted geometry: Muse Spark via T3 Code.
Adaptations: expanded quantized attributes to float32 for Godot compatibility,
rescaled/repositioned furniture, additional wood and fabric shaders.

ClassicNightstand 01 — Kirill Sannikov / Poly Haven, via Innerscene.
https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/victorian-nightstand-28fb8e24
Original PBR textures retained; scale adjusted.

Cartridge fuse 10 x 38 mm gG 16 A — Innerscene, original unbranded model.
https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/cartridge-fuse-10-x-38-mm-gg-16-a-32915eb2
Scale and orientation adjusted for the operator fuse pickup.

Keypad geometry, grille framing, additional surface shaders and animation code
were authored for KALA; no model/texture from the reference keypad game was copied.
